description: Reduced gzip, NPZ/RDS and read-before-overwrite boundary from live mixed-language scientific workflows, including base R write destinations; not an original model transcript.

cells.code:
con <- gzfile('inputs/signal.tsv.gz', 'rt')
records <- read.delim(con)
close(con)
saveRDS(records, 'outputs/raw.rds')
write.table(records, 'outputs/signal.tsv', sep='\t', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)

import numpy as np
records = np.loadtxt('outputs/signal.tsv', delimiter='\t', skiprows=1)
signal = records[:, 1]
power = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(signal)) ** 2
np.savez('outputs/spectrum.npz', signal=signal, power=power)
np.savetxt('outputs/power.tsv', power, fmt='%.17g')

records <- readRDS('outputs/raw.rds')
reference <- Mod(fft(records$value)) ** 2
observed <- scan('outputs/power.tsv', quiet=TRUE)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(reference[seq_along(observed)]), observed)))
saveRDS(list(power=observed, verified=TRUE), 'outputs/verified.rds')
write('python-pending', 'outputs/report.txt')

from pathlib import Path
with np.load('outputs/spectrum.npz', allow_pickle=False) as saved:
    assert np.allclose(saved['power'], [0, 0, 16, 0, 0])
previous = Path('outputs/report.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert previous == 'python-pending\n'
Path('outputs/report.txt').write_text('python-reviewed\n', encoding='utf-8')

restored <- readRDS('outputs/verified.rds')
previous <- readLines('outputs/report.txt')
stopifnot(identical(previous, 'python-reviewed'), restored$verified)
base::write('r-verified', file='outputs/report.txt')
cat('NATIVE_HANDOFF_OK\n')
